summary: Iter 43 P0 base64-leak fix + lazy avatar + admin migration verified. Backend pytest 15/15 PASS. All P0 acceptance criteria met: GET /api/vehicles NEVER contains 'data:image' even with 500KB base64 injected directly into DB; /auth/me strips base64 avatar and exposes has_avatar flag; new /auth/avatar/{user_id} endpoint streams base64 as image/png with Cache-Control public,max-age=86400 (verified on localhost — Cloudflare edge rewrites to no-store, ingress concern only); /marketplace/listings drops photos array and sanitises seller.avatar; admin migration endpoint is idempotent and returns correct counters shape. Iter 42 photo guard still 413s oversized inline base64. Single vehicle GET still returns full photos array (by design).

minor.issue: Cloudflare edge rewrites Cache-Control from backend-issued 'public, max-age=86400' to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. Verified backend is correct via localhost:8001 (returns public,max-age=86400). Infrastructure / ingress concern — avatars won't be browser-cached in production preview until CDN caching rule is added for /api/auth/avatar/*.

verified_features: P0 PASS — GET /api/vehicles response text asserted to NOT contain 'data:image' even after directly writing 500KB base64 to DB (bypassing iter42 guard). photos[] field dropped from every list item. cover_photo=null for base64-only, cover_photo=thumb_url when URL present, mixed arrays correctly skip base64 and resolve to first https:// URL.
P0 PASS — GET /api/auth/me returns avatar=null + has_avatar=true when profile.avatar is base64; response body <5KB. When avatar is https URL, returned as-is with has_avatar=true.
PASS — GET /api/auth/avatar/{user_id}: base64 → 200 image/png with decoded binary body; URL → 302 with Location header; missing avatar → 404; unknown user → 404.
P0 PASS — GET /api/marketplace/listings never leaks 'data:image' even after direct DB injection of 500KB base64; item.photos dropped; item.cover_photo = null (base64) or URL (dict).

P1 PASS — POST /api/admin/migrate/base64-photos-to-r2: unauthenticated → 401. With admin token → 200 with {vehicles:{migrated,failed,skipped}, listings:{...}, duration_seconds}. Idempotency verified: vehicle pre-seeded with URL-dict photos array is unchanged after migration run.
REGRESSION Iter 42 guard PASS — POST /api/vehicles with 400KB single base64 photo still 413 photo_too_large_inline.
REGRESSION single vehicle PASS — GET /api/vehicles/{id} still returns full photos array with dict entries (design contract for detail page).
REGRESSION Iter 41 loop-fix PASS — Garbage JWT on /garage 15s window: 0 requests to /api/marketplace/messages/threads, 1 request to /api/auth/refresh (single-flight enforced).
action_items: OPTIONAL infra — Add Cloudflare cache rule for /api/auth/avatar/* so the backend-issued Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400 survives to the browser. Currently CDN rewrites to no-store, defeating the lazy-load design goal (avatars will re-fetch every navigation). Backend code itself is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: _safe_cover_url (vehicles.py:107) correctly rejects strings not starting with http(s):// — but silently returns None for non-dict, non-str shapes. Consider a debug log for observability during migration.

auth.py:480 avatar endpoint has no auth check — public by design (avatars are public assets). Confirm this matches privacy_settings.profile_public intent; a private-profile user's avatar is currently still fetchable by user_id.

admin.py migration counters: when a vehicle has empty photos, it's counted as 'skipped'; when a vehicle has photos but NONE changed (all already URLs/dicts), also counted as 'skipped'. The 'skipped' counter conflates two states — consider splitting into skipped_empty vs skipped_already_migrated for clearer telemetry.

marketplace.py:262 uses runtime `try/except` import of _safe_cover_url — could be a top-level import since vehicles.py is a sibling router with no cyclic dep. Runtime try/except silently degrades to inline fallback.
test_iter43.py added and verifies acceptance metric: response.text.find('data:image') on both list endpoints. This should stay as a permanent regression gate.
